name: duopore-public-relocation-source-freshness
description: See which moving-research sources are old enough to need another check.

interface.longDescription: See which moving-research sources are old enough to need another check. Share public links, the dates you checked them and your chosen age limit. Get a list of sources to revisit first. The tool compares those dates only. It does not open links, check page changes or confirm that the information is still correct.
defaultPrompt: Which of my moving-research sources should I check again?
Flag sources older than my chosen review limit.

positive.prompt: Use Source Freshness Checklist with these explicitly supplied fictional inputs. Return the worksheet and limitations for my review: {"asOf":"2026-10-10","maxAgeDays":30,"sources":[{"id":"S1","url":"https://example.com/guide","checkedDate":"2026-08-01","topic":"Utility setup"},{"id":"S2","url":"https://example.com/checklist","checkedDate":"2026-10-01","topic":"Move preparation"}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Use only these supplied inputs; no external verification, saving, sending or invented facts. review.commerce_description: Free useful computation. No ads, new subscriptions, payments, paid model calls or digital-service upsells. Separate commercial hypotheses are internal planning only.

publication.release_notes: Clear benefit-first descriptions and original bold geometric branding with light/dark icon variants. App behavior, privacy, connections and review evidence unchanged.
